perks.desc: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.desc: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.

perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Counterattack
perks.desc: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Duelist's Trance
perks.desc: Sword final blows grant increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Counterattack
perks.desc: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Whirlwind Blade
perks.desc: Rapid sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for a short duration. Guarding also ends the effect.

perks.name: Assassin's Blade
perks.desc: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Valiant Charge
perks.desc: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.
